identity.headline: Building AI systems end to end: data, models, evaluation and production delivery.
identity.name: Manjunatha M.
identity.overview: I design and build AI systems end to end, from data pipelines and model architecture through evaluation to production delivery. My public work includes a domain-specific financial language model trained from scratch, an on-device speech pipeline for Android, an LLM evaluation framework for generative applications, and local-first observability tooling for AI agents. I care about measurable quality, cost-aware architecture and systems that remain maintainable after launch.

repos.description: Local-first desktop observability, tracing and threat detection for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP, OpenTelemetry)
repos.excerpt: See what AI agents are doing on your computer, and get told when it looks risky. Cortextrace is a local-first desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. It discovers AI coding agents and AI tools on your machine and traces every session: commands, file changes, tool and MCP calls, network destinations, approvals. It also runs a real-time detection engine that explains why something is risky. Nothing leaves your machine unless you configure an export. > Cortextrace is a defensive observability tool. It runs visibly (window and tray), needs no elevated privileges, never bypasses OS security controls and never collects file contents. Download the installer for your platform from Releases: Launch it. The first-run guide shows exactly what is monitored and which agents it found, and lets you connect hooks. See docs/INSTALL.md. Requires Node.js 24+. Read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the full design, docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md for the event model and docs/ADAPTERS.md to add an agent. - Installation · Privacy · Threat model - Architecture · Event schema · Detection & risk - Adapters, custom agents & API · Design decisions - Releasing & code signing · Contributing · Security policy The illustrated pro

repos.description: AURA - ambient AI voice assistant for Android: on-device VAD, Opus, Whisper transcription, Gemini 4-pillar summaries, action-item automation. Free-tier infrastructure.

repos.description: India's Sovereign Financial Language Model — 152M params, Clifford algebra + THGA attention + RASOAP optimizer
repos.excerpt: TOON-LLM Sovereign Apex v5.0 is India's first sovereign financial language model — a 152-million-parameter architecture purpose-built for Indian financial markets, regulations, and language. It combines novel geometric deep learning primitives (Clifford algebra, hyperbolic geometry, symplectic structure) with Mixture-of-Experts routing and a custom optimizer. > Project Status: Active pre-training on GTX 1650 (Phase-0 POC). Step 15,700 / 50,000 (31%). Target completion: July 2026. --- --- Model specs: d_model=768, n_layers=6, n_heads=12, d_clifford=24, n_experts=8, vocab=32K, max_seq=512 Parameter count: 152,786,352 (152M trainable) --- --- The model is trained on a curated multi-domain financial corpus covering: - Equity Markets — NSE/BSE tick data, OHLCV, order flow - Macro Economics — RBI publications, GDP, inflation, monetary policy - Corporate Filings — Annual reports, balance sheets, P&L statements - Regulatory Docs — SEBI circulars, compliance frameworks - News & Sentiment — Financial news, earnings calls, analyst reports - Derivatives — Options chains, futures, volatility surfaces - Crypto — BTC/ETH/altcoin market microstructure - Fixed Income — Government bonds, corporate d

repos.excerpt: A production-ready Email Generation Assistant powered by Google Gemini API with advanced prompt engineering, custom LLM-based evaluation metrics, model comparison analysis, and a professional web UI. Built as an AI Engineering assessment demonstrating prompt engineering, evaluation framework design, and full-stack delivery. --- --- Edit .env and replace your-google-api-key-here with your actual Google AI API key from Google AI Studio. Open http://localhost:8000 in your browser. --- The web UI provides 4 pages: - Compose — Generate emails with tone selection, scenario loading, and one-click copy - Compare — Side-by-side generation in two different tones simultaneously - Library — Browse all saved emails filtered by tone, with detail modals - Analytics — Dashboard with total count, latency, tokens, tone distribution chart Keyboard shortcuts: 1-4 navigate pages, D toggles dark mode, Ctrl+Enter generates, ? shows all shortcuts. --- --- The advanced strategy combines three techniques: 1. Role-Playing — The LLM assumes the persona of a senior executive communications specialist with 15+ years of experience 2. Few-Shot Examples — 4 curated examples (one per tone) embedded in the system pr
